title: Professional Email Product Change and Migration Terms
content:
Which moves between Professional Email products each product allows, and what a migration costs.

| Product | Move up mid-term allowed | Products it may move up to mid-term | Move down only at renewal | Mailbox data must fit the lower product before a downgrade |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | Yes | Harborline Mail Plus; Harborline Mail Pro | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline Mail Plus | Yes | Harborline Mail Pro | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline Mail Pro | No | none | Yes | Yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | Yes | Microsoft 365 Business Standard; Microsoft 365 Business Premium | Yes | Yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | Yes | Microsoft 365 Business Premium | Yes | Yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | No | none | Yes | Yes |

## Between the two families

No product can switch in place between Harborline Mail and Microsoft 365 Business; such a move needs a new subscription and a migration.

| Product family | Free mailbox migration by Harborline from | Fee per mailbox migrated below that seat count (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter, Plus and Pro | 5 seats | 9.99 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Standard and Premium | 10 seats | 14.99 |

## Points of judgement

- Harborline Mail Pro and Microsoft 365 Business Premium have no mid-term move up.
- Hypothetical: a migration of 3 mailboxes on a Harborline Mail product is below the 5-seat threshold, so the fee is 3 times 9.99, that is 29.97 USD; a migration of 12 seats on a Microsoft 365 Business product is at or above 10 seats and is free.
